user_workflow_reconfirmed.before_new_experiment: Search all-game historical ledger plus reviewed addenda for the affected code path, hypothesis and previous negative outcomes. A retry must identify the genuinely changed evidence or source.
user_workflow_reconfirmed.keep: Evidence of a corrected generic behavior in logs or graphics is sufficient to KEEP that behavior; the whole game need not become fully rendered first.
user_workflow_reconfirmed.merge: Promote the reviewed compatible implementation through a real PR to main and record its actual merge SHA. A build pass alone is not runtime behavior proof. An algorithm already merged must be verified still present, not duplicated. Conflicting/unsafe ports or unexercised candidates are explicitly pending rather than falsely called merged.
user_workflow_reconfirmed.preserve: Subsequent source manifests must retain accepted fixes, even while unrelated missing materials remain. Do not discard a proven correctness fix just because complete scenery remains broken.
user_workflow_reconfirmed.record_every_attempt: Keep preflight errors, build failures/warnings, crashes, unchanged visuals, no-match/unexercised paths, rejections, rollback decisions and positive results. Preserve exact source/ELF/archive hashes, actual game scope and a falsifiable next step; never rewrite failed history.
